title: cms.submission.erased payload
description:
Published by Abeon CMS when a submission is erased: at the reader's request or when the form's retention ran out. Every consumer of `cms.form.submitted` deletes what it derived from that submission.

The file name is the routing key.

site_id.description: The CMS site inside the organisation's instance.

form_id.description: The form, the same in every language.

submission_id.description: The submission's public id; the same in the panel's address and in the erasure event.
